# UQDA Core v0.1.4

This terminal-experience release makes UQDA's operator tools easier to scan,
safer to automate, and cleaner to interrupt. It supersedes v0.1.3 without
changing the UQDA wire protocol, identity/address derivation, group-password
derivation, configuration format, or peer compatibility.

## Consistent terminal design

- Adds restrained semantic colors to `uqdactl`.
- Uses green for healthy or connected state, yellow for warnings, red for
  failures, and cyan for headings and labels.
- Improves the visual hierarchy of doctor results, administration tables, and peer state and RTT.
- Keeps explicit status words in every colored result so color is never the
  only indication.

## Safe automation and accessibility

- Enables color automatically only when human-readable output is attached to an
  interactive terminal.
- Respects the `NO_COLOR` convention and terminals marked `TERM=dumb`.
- Keeps JSON and redirected output free of ANSI escape sequences.
- Adds `uqdactl -color=auto|always|never`.
- Preserves table alignment when ANSI styling is enabled.

## Validation

The release quality gate reruns:

- deterministic color policy, `NO_COLOR`, redirected-output, clean-JSON, and
  ANSI-safe table alignment tests;
- interrupted-process exit-status and temporary-file cleanup tests;
- Race Detector, formatting, linting, CodeQL, reachable dependency scanning,
  and handshake fuzzing;
- Linux, macOS, and Windows builds/tests plus FreeBSD and OpenBSD cross-builds with supported Go toolchains;
- privileged two-node, multi-hop, failover, loss/latency, and
  secure-required mesh scenarios;
- installer and Homebrew Cask tests; and
- checksum generation, keyless Sigstore verification, and GitHub provenance
  attestations for the published artifacts.

UQDA remains an encrypted overlay rather than an anonymity system and has not
yet received an independent security audit. Keep the IPv6 firewall enabled and
protect the node configuration and administration endpoint.
